title: Freestanding Paper Towel Holder 14-Inch Solid Brass Weighted Base | Allied Brass
short_title: Freestanding Paper Towel Holder 14-Inch | Allied Brass
description:
Add convenient, no-mount storage to your kitchen counter with this freestanding paper towel holder, crafted from solid brass with a weighted base to help prevent tipping.

Highlights:
- Freestanding design keeps paper towels within reach without wall mounting
- Solid brass construction for enduring everyday use
- Weighted base helps keep the holder steady during tear-off
- Felt pad helps protect countertops from scratches
- Available in a wide variety of designer finishes

Specs:
- Type: Countertop paper towel holder
- Material: Brass
- Mounting type: Freestanding
- Overall size: 5-Inch L x 5-Inch W x 14-Inch H
- Product weight: 4.8 lb
- Assembly: No assembly required
- Included: Paper towel holder
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
